verdict.rationale: Tempo docs say you can "link your tracing data with logs and metrics" and "generate metrics from spans", which is the core of the story. Related evidence supports a connected workflow: exemplars jump from metrics to traces, Explore switches from metrics to logs with preserved label filters, and the knowledge graph connects metrics, logs, and traces. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific span-to-logs and span-to-metrics click-through (e.g. how correlation is configured), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end debugging workflow.
